Keuangan: menyajikan laporan keuangan yang akurat untuk analisis bisnis yang lebih baik.

id.title: Backoffice DLIK OJK
id.summary: Sistem backoffice LMS untuk mengelola pelatihan, webinar, dan peringkat peserta di OJK.
body: Situs ini adalah Learning Management System (LMS) yang dirancang untuk mengelola program pelatihan, webinar, serta ringkasan peringkat peserta berdasarkan aktivitas mereka. Sistem ini menyediakan pelacakan pembelajaran, analisis kebutuhan pelatihan, dan laporan statistik bagi administrator.
Platform ini dibangun untuk meningkatkan efektivitas pelatihan digital, menyajikan analitik data peserta, dan memungkinkan interaksi yang fleksibel dalam proses e-learning.
features: Dasbor peringkat tertinggi: menampilkan peringkat peserta berdasarkan aktivitas pelatihan.
Memuat rincian seperti nama pengguna, periode pelatihan, surel, total poin, hadiah, dan frekuensi.
Dilengkapi pencarian dan penyaringan berdasarkan periode pelatihan.
Memungkinkan pengguna mengekspor data ke format Excel dan CSV.
Manajemen pelatihan dan webinar: memudahkan pengelolaan pelatihan e-learning.
Admin dapat menyusun materi pelatihan dalam berbagai format seperti video, dokumen, dan kuis interaktif.
Pengguna dapat mengikuti webinar yang dikelola di dalam sistem.
Tersedia dasbor webinar untuk memantau statistik peserta dan efektivitas webinar.
Poin belajar dan hadiah: sistem memberikan poin kepada peserta sesuai keterlibatan mereka dalam pelatihan.
Peserta dapat menukarkan poin dengan hadiah seperti merchandise (kaus, tas, pouch, dan lainnya).
Manajemen templat: admin dapat membuat dan mengelola templat untuk keperluan seperti penyusunan laporan atau sertifikat pelatihan.
Obrolan dan forum: fitur interaktif untuk berdiskusi, bertanya, dan berbagi wawasan seputar pelatihan dan webinar.
Notifikasi dan profil pengguna: pengguna menerima pemberitahuan mengenai jadwal pelatihan dan webinar.
Setiap peserta memiliki halaman profil yang menyimpan informasi pribadi dan riwayat pelatihan.

en.title: Backoffice DLIK OJK
en.summary: A back-office LMS for managing training programmes, webinars, and participant rankings at OJK.
body: This website is a Learning Management System (LMS) designed to manage training programs, webinars, and participant ranking summaries based on their activities. The system provides learning tracking, training needs analysis, and statistical reports for administrators.
This platform is designed to enhance digital training effectiveness, provide participant data analytics, and enable flexible interaction in e-learning processes.
features: Highest Ranking Dashboard Displays participant rankings based on their training activities.
Includes details such as User Name, Training Period, Email, Total Points, Rewards, and Frequency.
Features search and filtering options based on training periods.
Allows users to export data in Excel and CSV formats.
Training and Webinar Management Facilitates e-learning training management.
Admins can organize training materials in various formats such as videos, documents, and interactive quizzes.
Users can participate in webinars managed within the system.
A webinar dashboard is available to track participant statistics and webinar effectiveness.
Learning Points & Rewards The system awards learning points to participants based on their engagement in training.
Participants can redeem rewards such as merchandise (T-shirts, bags, pouches, etc.) based on accumulated points.
Management Template Admins can create and manage templates for various purposes, such as report generation or training certificates.
Chat & Forum An interactive feature that allows users to discuss, ask questions, and share insights related to training and webinars.
Notifications & User Profile Users receive notifications about training schedules and webinars.
Each participant has a user profile page storing personal information and training history.

Sistem ini menyediakan alur kerja yang efisien dan transparan untuk mengelola pesanan pembelian, persetujuan, penetapan harga, serta pelacakan persediaan. Hasilnya, kendali atas aktivitas pengadaan menjadi lebih baik sehingga efisiensi operasional dan pengambilan keputusan ikut meningkat.
Sistem ini cocok bagi perusahaan yang ingin membenahi operasi pengadaan, memperketat kendali biaya, dan memastikan koordinasi yang mulus antara proses pembelian, persediaan, dan persetujuan.

Persetujuan harga jual: mengelola dan menyetujui penyesuaian harga produk.

en.title: Dinamika
en.summary: A procurement management system that streamlines purchase orders, approvals, pricing, and inventory.
body: Dinamika is a comprehensive procurement management system designed to streamline the purchasing process. It provides an efficient and transparent workflow for managing purchase orders, approvals, pricing, and inventory tracking. The system ensures better control over procurement activities, enhancing operational efficiency and decision-making.
This system is ideal for businesses looking to improve their procurement operations, enhance cost control, and ensure seamless coordination between purchasing, inventory, and approval processes.
features: Dashboard: Provides an overview of procurement activities and key metrics.
Sales Price Approval: Manages and approves price adjustments for products.
Cylinder Approval: Handles approval processes related to cylinder transactions.
Pricelist Management: Maintains product pricing information.
Draft Purchase Order (PO): Allows users to create and manage draft purchase orders before approval.
Draft PO Approval: Reviews and approves draft purchase orders.
Purchase Order (PO) Management: Tracks, manages, and approves purchase orders.
Procurement: Oversees purchasing activities and vendor transactions.
Goods Receipt: Records and manages the receipt of purchased goods.
Purchase Return: Manages the return of purchased goods when necessary.
Booking Management: Handles product reservations for procurement planning.

Points & Rewards System Participants earn learning points based on their engagement.

Discussion Forum & Chat Allows participants to interact, discuss, and share insights about training modules.

User Profile Each participant has a personal profile page to track their learning history, module progress, and accumulated points.

OJKI Webinar & Webinar Dashboard Manages and hosts webinars related to training programs.

en.title: Megaria Hotel
en.summary: A hotel management system covering data, payroll, assets, reporting, and security.
body: This website is a hotel management system called Megaria Hotel. It is designed to assist hotel operations, including data management, payroll, assets, reports, security, and global settings. With a simple user interface and clear navigation, users can easily access the available features.
features: Dashboard: Overview of hotel operations and quick access to main modules.
Data SP: Management of official documents and administrative records.
Master Data: Manage categories, suppliers, and system references.
Payroll: Employee salary and payroll management.
Reports: Generate and export operational reports.
Assets: Manage hotel inventory and track assets.
Security: User access control and system security settings.
Global Settings: System-wide configurations and preferences.
User Management: Manage user accounts and access rights.

id.title: MG Schedule
id.summary: Platform penjadwalan proyek dan manajemen tugas dengan kalender dinamis serta pelaporan.
body: MG Schedule adalah platform manajemen jadwal milik Morning Glory Enterprise yang menawarkan solusi intuitif dan efisien untuk penjadwalan proyek dan manajemen tugas. Platform ini dirancang untuk merapikan alur kerja, mengoptimalkan pembagian tugas, dan mempererat kolaborasi di dalam organisasi.

Platform ini memungkinkan tim berkolaborasi secara efektif, menyusun prioritas tugas, dan menuntaskan proyek tepat waktu. Dengan tampilan kalender yang enak dilihat dan fitur pelaporan yang tajam, MG Schedule menjadi alat yang mengubah cara pengelolaan proyek perusahaan.
features: Ikhtisar dasbor: tampilan kalender dinamis yang menyajikan tugas dan jadwal proyek harian, mingguan, dan bulanan untuk pengelolaan waktu yang efisien.
Manajemen proyek induk: kendali menyeluruh atas proyek berjalan dan mendatang, termasuk pelacakan status dan pengelolaan tonggak capaian.
Pengelompokan tugas: menata tugas berdasarkan jenis dan prioritas agar pelaksanaannya berjalan lancar.
Pelacakan waktu: memantau waktu yang dihabiskan pada berbagai tugas dan proyek untuk analisis produktivitas.
Pembaruan proyek: mengikuti perubahan proyek dan pembaruan tugas terkini.
Manajemen lembur: memantau dan mengelola lembur proyek demi menjaga efisiensi.
Laporan harian dan mingguan: menyusun laporan terperinci untuk melacak kemajuan dan mengenali hambatan.
Manajemen kuota cuti: pelacakan kuota cuti anggota tim secara langsung.
Antarmuka ramah pengguna: desain bersih dengan tata letak yang mudah dinavigasi untuk mendorong produktivitas.

en.title: MG Schedule
en.summary: A project scheduling and task management platform with a dynamic calendar and reporting.
body: The MGE (Morning Glory Enterprise) Schedule Management Platform offers an intuitive and efficient solution for project scheduling and task management. The platform is designed to streamline workflows, optimize task allocation, and enhance collaboration within the organization.

This platform empowers teams to collaborate effectively, prioritize tasks, and deliver projects on time. With its visually appealing calendar and insightful reporting features, MGE Schedule is a game-changing tool for managing enterprise projects efficiently.
features: Dashboard Overview: A dynamic calendar display that presents tasks and project schedules for each day, week, and month, allowing for efficient time management.
Master Project Management: Comprehensive control over ongoing and upcoming projects, including status tracking and milestone management.
Task Categorization: Organize tasks by type and priority to ensure smooth execution of responsibilities.
Time Tracking: Monitor the time spent on different tasks and projects for better productivity analysis.
Project Updates: Stay informed with the latest project changes and task updates.
Overtime Management: Monitor and manage project overtime to maintain efficiency.
Daily and Weekly Reporting: Generate detailed reports to track progress and identify potential bottlenecks.
Leave Quota Management: Real-time tracking of available leave quotas for team members.
User-Friendly Interface: Clean design with an easy-to-navigate layout to boost user productivity.

id.title: Pabrik Plastik
id.summary: Sistem manajemen pabrik plastik untuk produksi, persediaan, limbah, dan transaksi.
body: Proyek ini adalah sistem manajemen pabrik plastik yang menyeluruh, dirancang untuk merapikan proses produksi, pelacakan persediaan, dan pengelolaan operasional. Sistem ini memuat modul pemantauan stok bahan, manajemen produksi roll dan kemasan, pelacakan limbah, serta penanganan transaksi. Dilengkapi kemampuan pelaporan dan ekspor data, sistem ini memastikan alokasi sumber daya yang efisien dan gambaran operasional yang selalu terkini.
features: Dasbor: menyajikan ikhtisar terpusat berupa total berat bahan, jumlah kelompok, dan kategori stok sehingga data produksi terbaca jelas.
Data induk: mengelola data pokok sistem seperti kategori, pemasok, dan rujukan lainnya.
Produksi roll: melacak dan mengelola kegiatan produksi roll.
Produksi kemasan: memantau dan mengelola proses produksi kemasan.
Produksi barang jadi: menangani produksi produk akhir yang siap didistribusikan.
Pengumpulan roll: mengelola pengumpulan dan pemakaian persediaan roll.
Manajemen limbah: memantau dan mengelola limbah produksi demi efisiensi sumber daya.
Pengepakan: mengawasi proses pengepakan produk jadi.
Transaksi: mencatat dan mengelola transaksi operasional terkait produksi dan perpindahan sumber daya.
Pelaporan: menyusun laporan terperinci dan mengekspor data ke Excel untuk dianalisis.
Manajemen pengguna: mengelola akun pengguna dan hak akses demi mengamankan operasional sistem.

en.title: Plastic Factory
en.summary: A plastic factory management system covering production, inventory, waste, and transactions.
body: This project is a comprehensive Plastic Factory Management System designed to streamline production processes, inventory tracking, and operational management. The system features modules for material stock monitoring, production roll and packaging management, waste tracking, and transaction handling. Equipped with reporting and data export capabilities, it ensures efficient resource allocation and real-time operational insights.
features: Dashboard: Provides a centralized overview of total material weight, group counts, and stock categories, ensuring a clear snapshot of production data.
Master: Manage essential master data for the system, such as categories, suppliers, and other references.
Production: Production Roll: Track and manage roll production activities.
Production Packaging: Monitor and manage packaging production processes.
Finished Goods Production: Handle production of final products ready for distribution.
Roll Collection: Manage roll inventory collection and usage.
Waste Management: Monitor and manage production waste to optimize resource efficiency.
Packing: Oversee the packing process for finished products.
Transactions: Record and manage operational transactions related to production and resource movements.
Reporting: Generate detailed reports and export data to Excel for analysis.
User Management: Manage user accounts and control access rights to secure system operations.

Reports and analytics for business insights.

body: Aplikasi web ini berfungsi sebagai sistem backoffice untuk platform Treeport, menyediakan fitur penting untuk penanganan data dan operasi administratif yang efisien. Antarmukanya yang bersih membuat navigasi mudah dan interaksi terasa ringan.
Platform ini mengoptimalkan tugas administratif dan penataan data demi meningkatkan efisiensi operasional.
features: Dasbor: pusat kendali yang menyajikan ikhtisar cepat aktivitas sistem beserta sapaan yang dipersonalisasi.
Kategori induk: mengelola dan menata berbagai kategori produk agar operasional lebih rapi.
Produk induk (variasi Flurry): menangani variasi produk secara terperinci demi pengelolaan produk yang menyeluruh.
Kebijakan privasi induk: menyusun dan memelihara dokumentasi kebijakan privasi perusahaan.
Pengaturan pengguna induk: mengelola data pengguna, termasuk membuat, mengubah, dan menghapus akun.
Pengaturan akses: mengatur peran dan izin pengguna demi pengelolaan akses yang aman dan efisien.

en.title: TreePort
en.summary: A back-office management system for the Treeport platform, handling data and administration.
body: This web application serves as a back-office management system for the Treeport platform, offering essential features for efficient data handling and administrative operations. Its clean interface ensures easy navigation and user-friendly interactions.
This platform optimizes administrative tasks and data organization to boost operational efficiency.
features: Dashboard: A central hub providing a quick overview of system activities and a personalized welcome for users.
Master Category: Manage and organize various product categories for streamlined operations.
Master Product (Flurry Variations): Handle detailed product variations to ensure comprehensive product management.
Master Privacy Policy: Configure and maintain company privacy policy documentation.
Settings: Master User: Manage user data, including creation, editing, and deletion of user accounts.
Access Settings: Control user roles and permissions to ensure secure and efficient access management.

The API supports HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with detailed documentation on parameters and response structures.
features: Tree Management: Add, update, delete, and retrieve tree data.
Species Management: Manage tree species data.
Location Management: Manage forest and planting area data.
User Management: User registration, authentication, and management.
Reports & Analytics: Tree growth data and forest health analysis.
Notifications: Send important alerts to users.
